INSERT INTO workflow_incidents (
  execution_id,
  workflow_id,
  workflow_name,
  failed_node,
  error_message,
  error_type,
  classification,
  classification_confidence,
  retry_attempted,
  retry_count,
  escalated
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.execution_id.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.workflow_id.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.workflow_id.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.failed_node || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.error_message || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.error_name || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.classification.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ Number($json.classification_confidence) }},
  false,
  0,
  false
)
ON CONFLICT (execution_id, classification)
DO UPDATE SET retry_attempted = workflow_incidents.retry_attempted;
RETURNING id;
